scope: Exploratory local shared-admission comparisons; all variants enforce the same quotas and current primary authorization. Source variants and incomplete production qualification are explained in the companion documentation.
limitations: Four clients; two-second arrival phases; owner database role; one host; no production workload/SLO.
Early variants predate global caller-policy binding and final deadline guard; there was no policy mismatch in these workloads.
Only the final observation includes aggregate Redis INFO metrics; earlier Redis cost values are unavailable, not zero.
Each source is a modified working tree based on the recorded commit; hashes identify actual inputs/binaries.
All unavailable responses and generator drops are retained.

metadata.topology: One host release Rust process, Node TLS proxy and load generator; Docker Percona primary plus separate Redis cache/limiter containers on loopback. Chromium provisions real login/SSO credentials.
unmeasured: multi-hour endurance and production arrival distributions

budgets.freshness: No stale grants for checks dispatched after committed reduction/revocation acknowledgement.
